finalCta.heading: Connect your platforms to build reports automatically — always see the truest state of your data.

hero.title: Data never stops, and marketing decisions happen in real time.
hero.description: Cluega can automatically pull historical and real-time data from the platforms you authorize, then build charts automatically. Skip the daily manual reporting work and see cross-platform data clearly at a glance.

countryRevenueChart.title: Revenue and spend analysis by country

reports.usMarketThermos: US market thermos product information research report
reports.tiktokCampingCup: TikTok camping thermos creative trend analysis

adFormatDonut.title: Ad format spend share
adFormatDonut.subtitle: Where budget was spent over the past 14 days.

engine.titleMuted: Built for every advertiser and media buying team,
engine.description: Automatically pull data, build charts in real time, and say goodbye to manual work. The moment performance shifts, see the state of your data at a glance and make the right marketing decision anytime.

ctrDecay.title: Drill into the details and see every ad clearly.
ctrDecay.description: Automatically track CTR fluctuations within 14 days after a video launches, accurately identify aging creatives, and prevent wasted ad budget.

audienceOverlap.title: See audience overlap in one chart and end ad auction cannibalization.
audienceOverlap.description: Visualize the audience overlap ratio across ad sets, and spot auction cannibalization risk at a glance. Exclude audiences with confidence and avoid wasted budget from duplicate delivery.

adRanking.title: Create dashboards teams actually use.
adRanking.description: Turn creative performance, conversion trends, and delivery priorities into a dashboard your team can read at a glance, so everyone knows which ad to push next.

items.mothersDayGift: Static image — Mother's Day gift set

collaboration.title: 14-Day Core Metrics: See campaign health at a glance.
collaboration.description: Aggregates 6 key metrics including ad spend, display frequency, CTR, and CPA. Helps you lock in on core data fluctuations anytime and make budget optimization decisions.

exploration.titleMain: long-term history and real-time data coexist seamlessly
exploration.description: No matter how large your accumulated historical ad data becomes, Cluega stores it with high precision and updates it continuously 24/7, helping you see changes in underlying metrics within seconds.

group.title: Sync core campaign data in real time
group.description: Data syncs and refreshes automatically. Continuously track core campaign dimensions such as impression frequency, CPA drift, audience overlap, and budget consumption efficiency, presenting the most accurate, delay-free account status in real time.

visual.ariaLabel: Creative health and core campaign metrics

budgetConsumptionEfficiency.title: Budget consumption efficiency
budgetConsumptionEfficiency.note: ▲ Pareto OK; 4 ad sets support 60% spend

target.title: Set targets and track progress
target.description: Compare live performance against goals so weekly reviews start with the right context.

hourlyReport.title: Track intraday performance hour by hour
hourlyReport.description: Follow spend, revenue, ROAS, and true cost per conversion at hourly granularity, comparing channels like TikTok, Meta, and Zalo hour by hour to quickly surface intraday anomalies and peak windows so you can adjust delivery within the flight.

history.title: Accumulate and analyze stored historical data
history.description: Cluega supports long-term historical data storage. You can compare accumulated remarketing custom audiences and spend changes from the past 60 days side by side, helping you see long-term trends clearly at key decision points.

visual.title: Monthly ad spend YoY analysis (2025 vs 2026)

impressionFrequencyTrend.title: Ad impression and frequency trends
impressionFrequencyTrend.description: Track the comparative changes between daily impressions and impression frequency. Understand overall traffic and audience saturation at a glance.

adFormatSpendShare.title: Ad format spend share
adFormatSpendShare.description: Visualize the budget consumption share and exact spend amount across different ad formats. Easily keep track of budget allocation for every type of creative.

brandVsNonbrandRoas.title: Brand vs non-brand ROAS share
brandVsNonbrandRoas.description: Compare ad spend and revenue distribution between brand and non-brand campaigns side by side. Understand the ROAS efficiency of creatives with different positioning at a glance.

cumulativeAdSpend.title: Cumulative ad spend
cumulativeAdSpend.description: Visualize the total accumulated spend across all ad platforms. Easily keep track of the overall budget consumption level at any time.

promptDashboard.title: Generate a marketing dashboard with one sentence
promptDashboard.description: Enter the metric prompt you want to view, and Cluega will automatically retrieve data from the platforms you authorized, build charts, and continuously sync updates in real time.

visual.step1Desc: Describe what you want to see in natural language
visual.step2Desc: AI identifies relevant platforms and fields
visual.step3Desc: Fetch latest data from Meta / Google / TikTok

weeklyPriorities.title: This week's priority adjustments
weeklyPriorities.description: Analyze multidimensional anomalies such as creative fatigue, audience overlap, and budget consumption, then rank them from most to least urgent. This helps you quickly lock onto marketing gaps.
